description: This file contains the CloudFrontClient class which provides methods to interact with the Amazon CloudFront service. It includes methods for creating signed URLs and cookies with detailed configuration options.

classes.name: CloudFrontClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon CloudFront, providing methods for distribution management and URL/cookie signing.

methods.name: getSignedUrl
methods.description: Creates a signed CloudFront URL using provided options such as URL, key pair ID, private key, and optional expiration or policy.

methods.name: getSignedCookie
methods.description: Creates signed cookies for CloudFront access, based on options like URL, key pair ID, private key, expiration, and policy.
